::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_methods/{pm}/delete_local"}
#docs
Refused with 409 while a live subscription pays with it or a payment on it is pending.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |
| `pm` | `string` | **yes** | The payment method's id (pm_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `payment_method`. One of `payment_method`. |
| `id` | `string` | The payment method id. |
| `deleted` | `boolean` | Always true. |
| `deleted_locally` | `boolean` | True only when we removed our record and left the gateway's copy. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Deleted locally |
| `404` | No such payment method |
| `409` | In use by a subscription or a pending payment |
